name: company-knowledge-qa
title: Company Knowledge Q&A
audience: Operations leader, team manager, or founder
summary: Answer practical company questions from supplied policies, SOPs, and approved documents, using the right version and scope.
free_result: Answers with exact sources, relevant next steps, and unresolved questions. Maintain a source/owner register and flag conflicting or outdated documents instead of blending them into an answer.
differentiator: Focus on trustworthy business answers across versions, locations, and operating rules. Include a source-authority template and repeatable update workflow. Merely telling an AI to answer from PDFs is too generic.
service_bridge: Internal AI assistants, permission-aware knowledge search, source connectors, and ongoing document synchronization.
paid_moment: We want this in the tools our employees use, connected to current documents and restricted by who is asking.
website_title: AI Assistant for Company Documents - Free Knowledge Skill
portuguese_query_themes: assistente IA para documentos da empresa
